facts.name: Index Account Definition
facts.sentence: An 'Index Account' is a sub-account where interest is credited based on the measured performance of an external index.

facts.name: No Direct Security Ownership
facts.sentence: An 'Index Account' does not involve direct ownership of any securities.

facts.name: Segment Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Segment' is a designated allocation unit within an Index Account.

facts.name: Segment Start Date Assignment
facts.sentence: Each Segment carries its own start date.

facts.name: Segments Have Individual End Dates
facts.sentence: Each Segment carries its own end date.

facts.name: Segment Crediting Parameters
facts.sentence: Each Segment carries its own crediting parameters.

facts.name: High-Water Mark Definition
facts.sentence: For applicable accounts, the High-Water Mark is the highest index value recorded on any monthly anniversary within the crediting period.

facts.name: Spread Deduction Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Spread' is a deduction applied to index gains prior to crediting.

facts.name: Spread vs Cap Rate Usage
facts.sentence: A Spread may be used in lieu of or in addition to a cap rate.

facts.name: Buffer Mechanism Definition
facts.sentence: For Buffer Accounts, a 'Buffer' is the percentage of index loss absorbed by the company before losses affect the account value.

facts.name: Crediting Period Definition
facts.sentence: The Crediting Period refers to the duration of a Segment.

facts.name: Crediting Period Duration
facts.sentence: The Crediting Period for a Segment is either 1 year or 2 years.

facts.name: Crediting Period Specification
facts.sentence: The Crediting Period length is specified per account.

facts.name: CVAT Definition
facts.sentence: CVAT stands for Cash Value Accumulation Test.

facts.name: CVAT Tax Method Election
facts.sentence: CVAT is the IRC §7702 tax qualification method elected for this policy.

facts.name: Survivorship Policy Definition
facts.sentence: A Survivorship Policy is defined as a policy insuring two lives where the death benefit is payable only upon the death of the second, or last surviving, insured.

facts.name: Blended COI Rate Definition
facts.sentence: The Blended COI Rate is defined as a composite mortality rate based on the ages, genders, and risk classes of both insureds.

facts.name: Blended COI Rate Calculation
facts.sentence: The Blended COI Rate is calculated actuarially to price survivorship coverage.

facts.name: Single Life Continuation
facts.sentence: Single Life Continuation refers to the period after the first insured's death during which the policy continues under modified COI calculation based solely on the surviving insured.

facts.name: Estate Multiplier Definition
facts.sentence: The Estate Multiplier is defined as the ratio of face amount to total planned premiums paid.

facts.name: Estate Multiplier Target
facts.sentence: The Estate Multiplier is designed to exceed 3:1 in this policy.

facts.name: Index Credit Definition
facts.sentence: An Index Credit is defined as interest applied to an account based on the measured change of a referenced market index.

facts.name: Guaranteed Interest Account Definition
facts.sentence: A Guaranteed Interest Account (GIA) is defined as the fixed rate account earning a declared, guaranteed interest.

facts.name: Key Definitions Overview
facts.sentence: Article 1 contains Key Definitions relevant to the policy.

facts.name: No-Lapse Guarantee Definition
facts.sentence: Section 1.1 defines 'No-Lapse Guarantee (NLG)' as a contractual guarantee that the policy will not lapse.

facts.name: NLG Payment Condition
facts.sentence: The No-Lapse Guarantee remains active only if the cumulative guaranteed premium has been paid on or before each due date.

facts.name: NLG Independent of Performance
facts.sentence: The No-Lapse Guarantee applies regardless of account value performance.

facts.name: NLG Premium Definition
facts.sentence: Section 1.2 defines 'NLG Premium' as the level annual premium amount required to activate the No-Lapse Guarantee.

facts.name: NLG Premium Location
facts.sentence: The NLG Premium amount is shown on the Policy Specifications page.

facts.name: Monthly NLG Compliance Check
facts.sentence: Section 1.3 defines the 'Cumulative NLG Test' as a monthly evaluation process.

facts.name: Cumulative NLG Test Definition
facts.sentence: The Cumulative NLG Test compares total premiums paid to date against total NLG premiums due to date.

facts.name: NLG Voidance Condition
facts.sentence: Failure to meet or exceed the total NLG premiums due to date results in the voiding of the No-Lapse Guarantee.

facts.name: Shadow Account Definition
facts.sentence: Section 1.4 defines the 'Shadow Account' as a notional ledger used solely to test NLG compliance.

facts.name: Shadow Account Separation
facts.sentence: The Shadow Account is calculated separately from the actual account value.

facts.name: Shadow Account Assumptions
facts.sentence: The Shadow Account uses conservative guaranteed assumptions for calculations.

facts.name: Protection Zone Duration
facts.sentence: Section 1.5 defines the 'Protection Zone' as policy years 1 through 20.

facts.name: NLG Coverage During Protection Zone
facts.sentence: During the Protection Zone, the No-Lapse Guarantee provides the primary coverage guarantee.

facts.name: Index Credit Definition
facts.sentence: Section 1.6 defines 'Index Credit' as non-guaranteed interest derived from market index performance.

facts.name: Index Credit Caps and Floors
facts.sentence: Index Credit is subject to both a cap and a floor.

facts.name: NLG Coverage Duration
facts.sentence: The No-Lapse Guarantee (NLG) provides coverage through the insured's age 90.

facts.name: NLG Premium Payment Requirement
facts.sentence: Coverage under the NLG requires payment of NLG premiums as required.

facts.name: Monthly Premium Comparison
facts.sentence: Each month, the total premiums paid to date (less withdrawals) are compared to the total NLG premiums due to date.

facts.name: NLG Premium Calculation Formula
facts.sentence: Total NLG premiums due to date equal $3,200 multiplied by the number of months divided by 12.

facts.name: NLG Activation Condition
facts.sentence: If total premiums paid to date (less withdrawals) is greater than or equal to total NLG premiums due to date, the NLG is active.

facts.name: NLG Suspension Condition
facts.sentence: If total premiums paid to date (less withdrawals) is less than total NLG premiums due to date, the NLG is suspended for that month.

facts.name: NLG Suspension Grace Period Trigger
facts.sentence: If the NLG is suspended in any month and the account value is insufficient to cover monthly charges, the policy enters a 61-day grace period.

facts.name: NLG Restoration Condition
facts.sentence: The NLG resumes immediately if cumulative payments are brought current before the end of the 61-day grace period.

facts.name: Loan Voidance Condition
facts.sentence: The NLG is permanently voided if there is any outstanding policy loan balance during the NLG guarantee period.

facts.name: Loan Voidance Condition
facts.sentence: The NLG is permanently voided if there is any outstanding policy loan balance including accrued interest during the NLG guarantee period.

facts.name: Partial Withdrawal Void Event
facts.sentence: The NLG is permanently voided if there is any partial withdrawal during policy years 1 to 10.

facts.name: NLG Void on Unpaid Premiums
facts.sentence: The NLG is permanently voided if cumulative unpaid NLG premiums are never remedied.

facts.name: Loan Voidance Rule
facts.sentence: Taking a loan permanently voids the No-Lapse Guarantee.

facts.name: Protection Product Focus
facts.sentence: This policy is primarily a protection product.

facts.name: Guaranteed Death Benefit
facts.sentence: During any year when the NLG is active, the full $1,000,000 death benefit is guaranteed.

facts.name: Guaranteed Death Benefit
facts.sentence: The full $1,000,000 death benefit is guaranteed regardless of account value during any year the NLG is active.

facts.name: Guaranteed Death Benefit
facts.sentence: The full $1,000,000 death benefit remains guaranteed even if the account value is zero during any year the NLG is active.

facts.name: Guaranteed Death Benefit
facts.sentence: The full $1,000,000 death benefit remains guaranteed even if the account value is negative during any year the NLG is active.

facts.name: NLG Coverage Extension
facts.sentence: The owner may extend NLG coverage beyond age 90 up to age 100.

facts.name: NLG Extension Premium Requirement
facts.sentence: Extending NLG coverage to age 100 requires payment of an additional rider premium of $400 per year.

facts.name: Rider Premium Start Age
facts.sentence: The additional rider premium begins at age 80.

facts.name: NLG Coverage Extension Governance
facts.sentence: Rider NLG-EXT governs the extension of NLG coverage.

facts.sentence: The rider premium is $400 per year.

facts.name: Rider Premium Start Age
facts.sentence: The rider premium begins at age 80.

facts.name: Accelerated Death Benefit Coverage
facts.sentence: Covered conditions under the accelerated death benefit include end-stage renal disease.

facts.name: Accelerated Death Benefit Rider
facts.sentence: The rider governing the accelerated death benefit is named Rider ADB-CRIT.

facts.name: Monthly Rider Charge
facts.sentence: A monthly rider charge of $4.50 applies to the accelerated death benefit rider.

facts.name: Loan Availability
facts.sentence: Loans are available under the policy.

facts.name: Loan Voidance of NLG
facts.sentence: Taking a loan permanently voids the No-Lapse Guarantee.

facts.name: Avoid Loans During NLG Dependence
facts.sentence: Policy owners should avoid taking loans when relying on the No-Lapse Guarantee for coverage certainty.

facts.name: Maximum Loan Amount Limit
facts.sentence: If a loan is taken, the maximum loan amount is 90% of the surrender value.

facts.name: Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The annual interest rate on policy loans is 5.5%.

facts.name: Loan Interest Earnings
facts.sentence: Loaned amounts earn at the fixed account minimum rate.

facts.name: Fixed Account Growth Rate
facts.sentence: The fixed account minimum rate is 2.25%.

facts.name: Partial Withdrawal Availability
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals are permitted after year 1.

facts.name: Withdrawal Voidance of NLG
facts.sentence: Withdrawals made between years 1 and 10 permanently void the No-Lapse Guarantee.

facts.name: Post-Year-10 Withdrawal Impact
facts.sentence: Withdrawals made after year 10 reduce the death benefit.

facts.name: Post-Year 10 Withdrawal Rules
facts.sentence: Withdrawals after year 10 do not affect the No-Lapse Guarantee status if the cumulative test remains current.

facts.name: Minimum Partial Withdrawal
facts.sentence: The minimum partial withdrawal amount is $500.

facts.name: Agent Consultation Advisory
facts.sentence: Guardian Shield strongly recommends consulting an agent before taking any loan or withdrawal.

facts.name: Protection-First Design
facts.sentence: This policy has a protection-first design.

facts.name: Year 1 Schedule Percentage
facts.sentence: Year 1 has a schedule percentage of 9% of account value.

facts.name: Year 2 Schedule Percentage
facts.sentence: Year 2 has a schedule percentage of 8% of account value.

facts.name: Year 3 Schedule Percentage
facts.sentence: Year 3 has a schedule percentage of 7% of account value.

facts.name: Year 4 Schedule Percentage
facts.sentence: Year 4 has a schedule percentage of 6% of account value.

facts.name: Year 5 Schedule Rate
facts.sentence: Year 5 has a schedule percentage of 5% of account value.

facts.name: Year 6 Withdrawal Schedule
facts.sentence: Year 6 has a schedule percentage of 4% of account value.

facts.name: Year 7 Withdrawal Schedule
facts.sentence: Year 7 has a schedule percentage of 3% of account value.

facts.name: Year 8 Surrender Charge Rate
facts.sentence: Year 8 has a schedule percentage of 2% of account value.

facts.name: Year 9 Withdrawal Schedule
facts.sentence: Year 9 has a schedule percentage of 1% of account value.

facts.name: Year 10 Withdrawal Rate
facts.sentence: Year 10 has a schedule percentage of 0.5% of account value.

facts.name: Year 11+ Schedule Rate
facts.sentence: Year 11+ has a schedule percentage of 0% of account value.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Basis
facts.sentence: Surrender charge basis is applied to account value at time of surrender.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Basis
facts.sentence: Surrender charge basis is not applied to premiums paid.

facts.name: Free Withdrawal Allowance
facts.sentence: A free withdrawal of 10% of account value per year is allowed.

facts.name: Free Withdrawal Start
facts.sentence: Free withdrawal begins in year 2.

facts.name: Free Withdrawal Exemption
facts.sentence: No surrender charge applies to free withdrawals.

facts.name: Withdrawal Voidance of NLG
facts.sentence: Any withdrawal in years 1–10 voids the No-Lapse Guarantee.

facts.name: Surrender Forfeits No-Lapse Guarantee
facts.sentence: Surrendering this policy forfeits the No-Lapse Guarantee.

facts.name: Early Surrender Value Loss
facts.sentence: Surrender value may be significantly less than premiums paid in early years.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Window
facts.sentence: A lapsed policy may be reinstated within 5 years of lapse.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstating a lapsed policy requires payment of all overdue NLG premiums.

facts.name: NLG Premium Interest Requirement
facts.sentence: Overdue NLG premiums must include interest at 6%.

facts.name: Reinstatement Evidence Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires satisfactory evidence of insurability.

facts.name: NLG Cumulative Test Reset
facts.sentence: NLG reinstatement causes the cumulative test to restart from the reinstatement date.

facts.name: Contestability Period Restart
facts.sentence: Contestability period restarts upon policy reinstatement.

facts.name: Suicide Period Restart
facts.sentence: Suicide period restarts upon policy reinstatement.

facts.name: Simplified Reinstatement Window
facts.sentence: Simplified reinstatement is available within 60 days of lapse.

facts.name: Simplified Reinstatement Exemption
facts.sentence: Simplified reinstatement does not require evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Simplified Reinstatement Requirement
facts.sentence: Payment of overdue premium is sufficient for simplified reinstatement.

facts.name: Proof of Insurability Required
facts.sentence: Evidence of insurability is required.

facts.name: Overdue Premium Reinstatement
facts.sentence: Payment of an overdue premium is sufficient to satisfy evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Suicide Benefit Limitation
facts.sentence: If death occurs by suicide within two years of issue, benefits are limited to the return of premiums less withdrawals.

facts.name: Suicide Benefit Limitation
facts.sentence: If death occurs by suicide within two years of reinstatement, benefits are limited to the return of premiums less withdrawals.

facts.name: Contestability Period Duration
facts.sentence: The contestability period lasts two years from the date of issue.

facts.name: Contestability Period Duration
facts.sentence: The contestability period lasts two years from the date of reinstatement.

facts.name: Aviation Exclusion Rule
facts.sentence: Aviation exclusion applies if the insured is a pilot or crew member of a non-commercial aircraft.

facts.name: Aviation Exclusion Exception
facts.sentence: Passenger travel on commercial scheduled airlines is fully covered under aviation exclusion.

facts.name: Hazardous Occupation Exclusion
facts.sentence: Hazardous occupation exclusion applies if the insured’s death results from being an underground miner.

facts.name: Hazardous Occupation Exclusion
facts.sentence: Hazardous occupation exclusion applies if the insured’s death results from working on an offshore oil platform.

facts.name: Hazardous Occupation Exclusion
facts.sentence: Hazardous occupation exclusion applies if the insured’s death results from being an explosive demolition worker.

facts.name: Hazardous Occupation Exclusion
facts.sentence: Hazardous occupation exclusion applies if the insured’s death results from engaging in a similar Category IV high-risk occupation as defined in the underwriting manual.

facts.name: Occupational Change Notification
facts.sentence: If the insured changes to a Category IV occupation, the owner must notify Guardian Shield within 30 days.

facts.name: Protection-Primary Classification
facts.sentence: This product is classified as a protection-primary product.

facts.name: Accumulation Benefits Availability
facts.sentence: Accumulation benefits are available under this product.

facts.name: Death Benefit Priority
facts.sentence: The NLG structure prioritizes death benefit certainty over cash value growth.

facts.name: Index Participation Excludes Dividends
facts.sentence: Index participation does not include dividends.

facts.name: Index Participation Clarification
facts.sentence: Index participation is not investment participation in any security.

facts.name: Guaranteed Shadow Account Assumptions
facts.sentence: NLG shadow account assumptions are guaranteed.

facts.name: Conservative Shadow Account Assumptions
facts.sentence: NLG shadow account assumptions are conservative.

facts.name: Account Value Discrepancy
facts.sentence: Actual account value may differ substantially from NLG shadow account assumptions.

facts.name: Non-Guaranteed Projections
facts.sentence: Illustration software projections are not guaranteed.

facts.name: NLG Death Benefit Guarantee
facts.sentence: Only the NLG death benefit guarantee is contractually binding.

facts.name: Company Location
facts.sentence: Guardian Shield Life Insurance Company is located in Phoenix, Arizona.

facts.name: Contact Number for Guardian Shield Life
facts.sentence: The telephone number for Guardian Shield Life is 1-877-GUARDIAN.

facts.name: Contact Email Address
facts.sentence: The email address for Guardian Shield Life is protect@guardianshieldlife.com.

facts.name: Seal Ownership
facts.sentence: The seal shown on the document belongs to Guardian Shield Life.

facts.name: President Title Designation
facts.sentence: The president of Guardian Shield Life Insurance Company holds the position titled 'President'.

facts.name: Issuance Date Confirmation
facts.sentence: The letter was issued on August 22, 2024.

facts.name: Official Seal Verification
facts.sentence: The document bears the official seal of Guardian Shield Life.

facts.name: Legally Binding Document

facts.name: Juvenile Policy Definition
facts.sentence: The term 'Juvenile Policy' refers to a life insurance policy issued on the life of a minor who is under age 18.

facts.sentence: A Juvenile Policy has ownership held by a parent, guardian, or another adult.

facts.sentence: The Payor Benefit waives premiums if the owner or payor dies.

facts.name: Payor Benefit Coverage
facts.sentence: The Payor Benefit also waives premiums if the owner or payor becomes disabled.

facts.name: Payor Benefit Activation
facts.sentence: If the Payor Benefit is activated due to the owner's death or disability, the juvenile policy remains in force.

facts.name: Guaranteed Insurability Right
facts.sentence: The 'Guaranteed Insurability Option (GIO)' grants the insured a guaranteed right to purchase additional life insurance.

facts.name: Guaranteed Insurability Right
facts.sentence: The Guaranteed Insurability Option allows the insured to buy additional coverage at specified intervals.

facts.name: Policy Continuation After Death
facts.sentence: The owner or payor can keep the juvenile policy in force if they die.

facts.name: Policy Continuation on Disability
facts.sentence: The owner or payor can keep the juvenile policy in force if they become disabled.

facts.name: Guaranteed Insurability Right
facts.sentence: The Guaranteed Insurability Option (GIO) grants the insured a guaranteed right to purchase additional life insurance.

facts.name: Guaranteed Insurability Right
facts.sentence: The guaranteed right under GIO applies at specified future dates.

facts.sentence: A death benefit of $150,000 is payable to the owner or parent upon the insured’s death while minor.

facts.name: Court Supervision for Minor Beneficiaries
facts.sentence: Life insurance proceeds on minors may be subject to court-supervised administration under applicable state law.

facts.name: No Contestability After Two Years
facts.sentence: There is no contestability clause on the death of a minor after a two-year period.

facts.name: Accelerated Death Benefit Eligibility
facts.sentence: An accelerated death benefit is available for terminal illness when life expectancy is less than 12 months.

facts.name: Minimum Acceleration Amount
facts.sentence: The minimum amount that can be accelerated is $25,000.

facts.name: Guaranteed Insurability Option Inclusion
facts.sentence: The Guaranteed Insurability Option (GIO) Rider is included in the policy.

facts.name: Guaranteed Insurability Access
facts.sentence: The GIO allows the insured to purchase additional life insurance at guaranteed future dates without providing evidence of insurability.

facts.name: GIO Effective Ages
facts.sentence: The GIO becomes effective at insured ages 22, 25, 28, 31, 34, 37, and 40.

facts.name: Maximum GIO Purchase Limit
facts.sentence: At each GIO date, the maximum amount that can be purchased is $150,000.

facts.name: Max GIO Purchase Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum purchase per GIO date equals 100% of the base coverage.

facts.name: GIO Triggers Beyond Age
facts.sentence: The GIO is also triggered by marriage, birth or adoption of a child, and graduation from a four-year college.

facts.name: GIO Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: Documentation is required to activate the GIO due to marriage, birth/adoption of a child, or college graduation.

facts.name: GIO Monthly Charge
facts.sentence: The monthly charge for the GIO is $0.50.

facts.name: Children's Term Rider Ineligibility
facts.sentence: The Children's Term Rider is unavailable on juvenile policies because the insured is already a child.

facts.name: Payor Benefit Rider Free
facts.sentence: The Payor Benefit Rider is included at no charge.

facts.name: Payor Death Benefit Activation
facts.sentence: If Marcus DeShawn Williams dies, the Payor Death Benefit applies.

facts.name: Payor and Owner Role
facts.sentence: Marcus DeShawn Williams is the payor and owner of the policy.

facts.name: Payor Death Premium Waiver
facts.sentence: If Marcus DeShawn Williams dies before the insured reaches age 25, all future planned premiums are waived.

facts.name: Planned Premium Amount
facts.sentence: Future planned premiums amount to $2,400 per year.

facts.name: Payor Death Benefit Duration
facts.sentence: Premium waiver due to payor death continues until the earlier of the insured reaching age 25 or policy surrender.

facts.name: Payor Disability Waiver
facts.sentence: If the payor becomes totally disabled according to the rider definition for six or more consecutive months, planned premiums are waived.

facts.name: Payor Disability Waiver Duration
facts.sentence: Premium waiver due to payor disability lasts for up to three years.

facts.name: Payor Benefit Termination at Age 25
facts.sentence: The payor benefit terminates when the insured reaches age 25.

facts.name: Payor Benefit Termination Condition
facts.sentence: The payor benefit terminates upon ownership transfer if that occurs earlier than the insured reaching age 25.

facts.name: Payor Benefit Free Under Age 5
facts.sentence: The payor benefit is free on juvenile policies where the insured is under age 5 at issue.

facts.name: Automatic Ownership Transfer
facts.sentence: On July 5, 2038, which is the insured’s 18th birthday, policy ownership automatically transfers to the insured.

facts.name: Ownership Transfer Trigger Condition
facts.sentence: Automatic ownership transfer to the insured only occurs if the owner does not file a written election to retain ownership.

facts.name: Written Election Requirement
facts.sentence: A written election to retain ownership must be filed at least 30 days before the automatic transfer date.

facts.name: Owner Retention Option
facts.sentence: The owner may retain ownership indefinitely by filing a written election.

facts.name: Annual Election Renewal Requirement
facts.sentence: Annual renewal of the written election is required each year after the insured turns 18.

facts.name: Collateral Assignment Right
facts.sentence: The owner may collateral assign the policy to a lender or educational institution.

facts.name: Collateral Assignment Exemption
facts.sentence: Collateral assignment does not trigger ownership transfer.

facts.name: Collateral Assignment Does Not Transfer Ownership
facts.sentence: Collateral assignment does not transfer ownership rights.

facts.name: Insured Beneficiary Change Right
facts.sentence: Upon receipt of ownership, the insured may change the beneficiary.

facts.name: Insured Loan Rights Post-Transfer

facts.name: Insured Withdrawal Rights Post-Transfer
facts.sentence: Upon receipt of ownership, the insured may make withdrawals from the policy.

facts.name: Insured Investment Control Post-Transfer
facts.sentence: Upon receipt of ownership, the insured may change investment allocations without restriction.

facts.name: Owner Funds During Minority
facts.sentence: Withdrawals made by the owner while the insured is a minor are considered the owner's funds.

facts.name: Owner Loans During Minority
facts.sentence: Loans taken by the owner while the insured is a minor are considered the owner's funds.

facts.name: No Fiduciary Obligation During Minority
facts.sentence: There is no fiduciary obligation owed to the insured minor by the owner unless required by state law.

facts.name: Owner Funds During Minority

facts.name: No Fiduciary Duty During Minority
